title: Extend _compute_kernel for surjective FpGroup homomorphisms
description: Modify the `_compute_kernel` method to handle surjective homomorphisms between FpGroups. The mathematical principle is: for a surjective homomorphism φ: G → H where G and H are FpGroups, the kernel is the normal closure in G of the lifts of the relators of H. The implementation should: (1) Add a new branch at the beginning of `_compute_kernel` that checks if both domain and codomain are FpGroups, (2) Check if the homomorphism is surjective using `is_surjective()`, (3) If surjective (or surjectivity cannot be determined for infinite groups), compute kernel generators by calling `_lift_relator` on each relator of the codomain, (4) Return an FpSubgroup with these lifts as generators and `normal=True`. This enables kernel computation for infinite FpGroups when the homomorphism is surjective.
expected_output: The modified `_compute_kernel` method that uses `_lift_relator` for surjective homomorphisms between FpGroups, properly handling both finite and infinite groups.
